compute_execution_accuracy: compute execution accuracy by comparing gold and predicted SQL answer lists
normalize_sql_answer: normalize SQL query answers by converting elements to lowercase strings with 2-decimal rounding
create_SqlEvaluation: create a SqlEvaluation instance with an EvaluationConfig to evaluate SQL model outputs
run_SqlEvaluation_evaluate: run SqlEvaluation.evaluate on an EvaluationInstance to compute per-turn execution accuracy metrics
review_SqlEvaluation: review the SqlEvaluation class and its evaluate method for SQL answer correctness checking
